Source [1] (EMC, 2015, pages 6-7) says the second stage of the MAV uses a single 100kN LOX/LCH4 pump-fed rocket engine with a specific impulse of 360 sec.

Source [2] (RM 1.0, 1997, pages 174-177) says the ascent propulsion system uses two RL10-class engines modified to burn LOX/CH4, which perform with an average specific impulse of 379 seconds throughout the MAV flight regime.

The sources differ.
